method: Independent exact-pixel validation of saved sheets, not their authoring functions. World anchor uses the original cell origin; no per-frame recentering. Pixel movement thresholds are in logical pixels.
holeMethod: Four-neighbour border flood fill, alpha exactly zero; only the original lookout S head hole may follow head movement.
headMetricClarification: The review calls its metric the head front but also calls it the rightmost opaque column. Fixed SE/NE foot pixels contradict a whole-frame limit. Report both whole-frame and rows 0-23 values; do not claim final acceptance of the ambiguous metric.
wholeFrameMetricConflicts: creature/SE/hurt: whole-frame x=38 > 36; original fixed foot pixels must remain
creature/SE/recovery: whole-frame x=38 > 37; original fixed foot pixels must remain
creature/NE/hurt: whole-frame x=35 > 34; original fixed foot pixels must remain
